title: Applet misleadingly says "no vaults have been set up" instead of a real error message when kded module wasn't loaded is or crashing
line: The Vaults applet now says when its background service isn't running, and shows your vaults again once it is back, instead of claiming none have been set up.
explanation: The applet asks the plasmavault kded module for its vaults over D-Bus, but when that call failed the model just returned, so the list stayed empty and the applet showed 'No Vaults have been set up'. After a kded crash KCrash restarts kded, which owns its D-Bus name before the module is there, so the applet's reload right then failed with an unknown object and it never asked again; the same happened whenever the module wasn't loaded. The model now first calls kded's loadModule("plasmavault"), which loads the module if needed and replies once it is there, and only then asks for the vaults. If either call fails, the applet says 'Vaults are unavailable' with a Try Again button and uses the error icon.

commits.message:
applet: show an error when the Vaults service is unavailable

When kded had just restarted or the plasmavault module wasn't loaded,
the failed D-Bus call was ignored and the applet claimed no vaults were
set up. Ask kded to load the module first, and say so if that fails.

BUG: 446437

media.caption: Master: after kded6 crashes and KCrash restarts it, the applet claims no vaults are set up although 'Here' exists
With the fix: same crash, the applet waits for kded to load the module and lists 'Here' again
Master: with kded6 not running, the applet says no vaults are set up and offers to create one
With the fix: kded6 not running gives 'Vaults are unavailable' with Try Again and a red tray icon

review.text: Solid fix that resolves both halves of the bug cleanly: asking kded6 to loadModule("plasmavault") before calling availableDevices() fixes the kded restart race without fragile retry timers, and exposing isServiceAvailable gives users an accurate error state with a Try Again action and error tray icon instead of falsely claiming no vaults exist. The code is clean, follows Plasma HIG/i18n conventions, and the verification covers kded crashes, stopped kded, failing module loads, and normal empty-vault behavior.
